text:
UNVERIFIED IMAGE READING (packet-08). Images only; no outside source consulted; no identification of work or author attempted.

LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
- 10 images. image-001 = overview of side A; image-002..005 = reading-size pieces of side A (002 top left, 003 top right, 004 bottom left, 005 bottom right); image-006 = overview of side B; image-007..010 = pieces of side B (007 top left, 008 top right, 009 bottom left, 010 bottom right).
- Object: a parchment piece wider than tall, with a vertical fold/gutter off-centre. It looks like part of a bifolium: one wide leaf written in long lines across its full width (about 28-29 lines visible; side A left / side B right), and beyond the fold a narrower strip of the conjugate leaf whose lines are cut off at the outer edge (side A right / side B left). Colour target and scale at the bottom of the overviews.
- No running titles. No rubricated headings. Three enlarged red initials, each two lines high, open new sections: "D" (side A wide leaf, image-004 l.3), "E" (side A narrow leaf, image-005 l.4), "V" (side B wide leaf, image-010 l.5). Red strokes touch capitals and paragraph marks within the lines. No underlining, no interlinear gloss in the main text; a few interlinear corrections/insertions (noted below). A short marginal mark at the outer top corner of side A (reddish, illegible).
- Damage: heavy staining and fading across the top 3-4 lines of every column; brown stain down the outer edge of the narrow leaf on both sides; small holes; a last line partly trimmed at the foot of side B wide leaf.
- Script: small rapid cursive-leaning book hand, brown ink, very heavily abbreviated.
- Tentative interpretation only: continuous prose in sections, each new section opening with a short quoted sentence at an enlarged initial followed by exposition that quotes further short phrases introduced by "V." (a recurring abbreviation, expansion not asserted; rendered V(nde)? below) and by enumerations ("p(rim)o ... s(ecund)o ... t(erci)o"). Lemma-like opening words are marked LEMMA? below where the layout shows them at an initial.

AREAS SELECTED
(1) Side A wide leaf: lines around and after the red "D" (image-004), plus the legible middle lines of image-002.
(2) Side B wide leaf: top block (image-008) and the section at the red "V" (image-010).
(3) Side B narrow leaf, lower part (image-009) - line beginnings lost at the left.
(4) Side A narrow leaf (image-003, 005) - sampled only; line ends lost at the right.
UNREAD: top three lines of every column (faded); most of image-007 (stained); most of image-003.

Conventions: (..) proposed expansion; ? uncertain; [illegible]; [...] loss; | line end or beginning lost at a cut edge; 7 = Tironian et.
